title: Personal Credit Cards: Billing Late Fees and Returned Payment Fees
content:
Personal Credit Cards bill a late fee when a statement's minimum payment is not met by its due date, and a returned payment fee when a payment comes back unpaid. This page sets out when each applies and how its amount is bounded; the fee amounts themselves differ by tier.

## Late fee

- A late fee arises when everything paid or credited to the card from the day a statement closes up to and including its due date falls short of that statement's minimum payment.
- Its amount is the tier's repeat late fee when at least one late fee, still unreversed, was billed in the tier's look-back of statement cycles immediately before the cycle being billed; otherwise it is the tier's first late fee. In either case it is never more than the minimum payment that was missed.
- The fee is booked as a late payment fee and belongs to the cycle of the statement whose due date passed unmet.
- Where a statement carries no minimum payment at all, it can never draw a late fee; and no statement ever bears more than one late fee, as the bank's records for that account and cycle show.

## Returned payment fee

When a payment is returned unpaid, the credit it gave is taken back by a payment return entry, and the tier's returned payment fee is billed, linked to the returned payment. That fee is capped at the minimum payment of the statement the returned payment was intended to settle.

## One fee per missed minimum

A single missed minimum payment may carry either a late fee or a returned payment fee, never both. Where the return is what leaves the minimum unmet by the due date, the late fee is the one that stands and no returned payment fee is added.

## Decision table

| Payments and credits in the window reached the minimum | A payment was returned | Fee billed |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | none |
| no, because the returned payment was the one that would have met it | yes | late fee only |
| no | no | late fee |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A statement's minimum is 22.00 USD and the cardholder paid nothing in the window. The tier's applicable late fee figure is higher than 22.00 USD, so the fee billed is 22.00 USD, the missed minimum.
